speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Longer shipping routes would increase fuel use, greenhouse gas emissions and pollution of the marine environment.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia has an obligation to prevent, reduce and control pollution of the marine environment under Article 194 UNCLOS.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions can qualify as marine pollution under UNCLOS, and Arcadia's Paris Agreement measures must remain ambitious.
